fluff.overview: Conventional infantry within the Clan touman fills the garrison and screening roles that battle armor and BattleMech forces cannot efficiently sustain across dozens of occupied worlds. Mechanized Wheeled Points use wheeled armored vehicles that balance speed and protection better than hovercraft or motorcycles. Effective on developed road networks and open terrain, they sacrifice the all-terrain capability of tracked vehicles for better sustained speed on firm ground. Support troops operate man-portable long-range missile launchers capable of engaging targets at distances well beyond personal weapon range, providing the Point with indirect fire capability against vehicles and fortified positions.
